, Reason for Mistake: The Planner reframed the task to compare US release dates and even asserted an unsupported 2015 US home-video date for Dis-Moi Qui Tuer. The question only requires which film came out earlier overall; the correct straightforward comparison is the original release years (1965 vs 2010).
